label: Using reference angles to rewrite angles
subgoals: Drop to the acute angle alpha against the x-axis
Strip multiples of 2pi to reach a standard form
Fix the sign from the quadrant of theta

label: Reduction formulas for \\( \pi/2 + \alpha \\)
subgoals: Rotate alpha past vertical into quadrant II
Swap to sin(pi/2 + alpha) = cos(alpha), cos = -sin(alpha)
Read the cosine minus sign off the unit circle

label: Reduction formulas for \\( \pi/2 - \alpha \\)
subgoals: Fold back from vertical into quadrant I
Swap to sin(pi/2 - alpha) = cos(alpha), cos = sin(alpha)
Keep all signs positive inside quadrant I
